title: Hatsune Miku's Leek (as a sword cit)
description: Adds Hatsune Miku's Leek as a CIT for swords! Available in both Vanilla CIT and Optifine CIT versions!
body:
## Adds Hatsune Miku's Leek! + Secret

![Thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afaa6aadb87d4b20ac8c49d947596e43021957f7.png)

# Warnings
Doesn't require optifine or cit resewn, UNLESS USING THE "Opti Cit" VERSION!

# Additions
The Download contains 2 versions of the pack
1 for 1.21.5 and above and 1 for all versions below
(Note for above: I think vanilla cit was added in 1.21.2 but I only tested these in 1.21.5 so do with that as you will.)
The following renames are NOT Cap Sensitive(Unless it's the 1.21.5 version)
### Rename any Sword to "Miku Leek", "Miku's Leek", or "Leek"
